problem.title: InTEn-LOAM KITTI 07: weak-translation prediction prior
problem.question: Does a fixed weak-translation prior prevent repeated biased S2S updates when recursive mapped prediction alone does not?

next_step: Review the uniform full-sequence experiment; repository extension stays default off.

variants.label: Mapped-motion reference
variants.intent: Mapped seed and acceleration on, row completion off in both arms. Only translation-prior ratio0/0.03 differs. Fixed before all full accuracy runs. Repository extension, default off; retain every negative outcome.
variants.note: InTEn-LOAM paper pipeline (FEF, S2S Alg. 1 with re-association, S2M Alg. 2 with TVF map, DOR gating map insertion); no GT seed. intensity=on mapping=on dor=on mean pairs s2s=1385 s2m=2307 dor points/frame=149; repository acceleration enabled (opt-in, not in the paper); S2S previous mapped-motion seed enabled (repository extension, opt-in); imported full paired experiment; timing is not a standalone speed measurement; actual argv in adjacent native_command.json
variants.readability_note: Adds extra tuning knobs and therefore more command complexity.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stable-interface compatible, but with a larger parameter surface.
variants.decision_reason: One candidate setting is evaluated across all sequences. No per-sequence adoption or default selection; the native option remains off.

host.capture_scope: Shared Docker runtime captured before acquisition, not an individual per-run timestamp.
